name: Nivolumab (single agent, previously treated clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Continuous single-agent nivolumab 240 mg IV every 2 weeks (or 480 mg every 4 weeks) until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Used after prior anti-angiogenic (TKI) therapy in IO-naive patients.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event monitoring across organ systems; counsel prompt symptom reporting.
Baseline and periodic thyroid, hepatic, adrenal, and glucose assessment.
monitoring: thyroid function (TSH/free T4) before cycles and as indicated
symptom review for colitis, pneumonitis, dermatitis, endocrinopathy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold nivolumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; permanently discontinue for severe or recurrent grade 3-4 events. Obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.notes: Nivolumab 240 mg IV flat every 2 weeks (days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle), or 480 mg every 4 weeks as a label-equivalent alternative. Single-agent second-line therapy for clear-cell RCC after prior TKI in IO-naive patients. Authored from standard practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; CheckMate-025 supporting evidence).

provenance.locator: single-agent nivolumab, previously treated clear-cell RCC
